summary: Tested Claude Sonnet 5 fallback in CineMind AI (backend pytest suite of 12 tests + Playwright UI flows on the public preview URL). Session seeded via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md (DB_NAME=test_database). Claude fallback works: taste-profile and recommendations both return provider='claude', used_demo/demo=false, with genuine LLM content, both when Ollama is unconfigured and when Ollama URL is unreachable. Frontend shows profile-provider-badge='Claude Sonnet 5' and toast '8 picks via Claude Sonnet 5'. Found and fixed one real 500 (ObjectId leak on auto-seed paths); reported 3 non-blocking product issues + 1 flaky behaviour.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: auto-seed branch returned pymongo-mutated docs still containing ObjectId _id -> 500 ValueError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"). Reproduced on a fresh user's first call. Same latent bug existed in GET /api/recommendations auto-seed branch. Both now exclude _id.

minor.issue: FLAKY (1/4 runs = ~25%): returned {provider:'demo', demo:true} even though Claude was reachable. No 'Claude call failed' in logs, so _extract_json() silently failed on Claude's output (likely truncated/non-JSON). Recommend logging raw LLM text on parse failure and one retry before dropping to DEMO_RECS.

Neither endpoint auto-seeds demo history the way GET /api/history does. A user who generates before visiting /dashboard has empty db.history, so the prompt has no titles: Claude answered 'With no viewing history yet on record...' with narrative_complexity=1 and empty top_genres, and recs were generic popular titles (Stranger Things, Grand Budapest Hotel) instead of personalized. Seed/require history inside these endpoints.
Claude never returns poster/backdrop URLs, so every generated rec falls back to the same hardcoded Unsplash cinema-seat image -> all 8 cards look identical in the grid and on /saved.

issues: All 8 Claude-generated cards render the identical Unsplash placeholder poster - grid reads as broken imagery; needs per-title poster lookup (e.g. TMDB) or varied placeholders
Subheading copy still hardcodes 'your Ollama model connects the dots' even though picks were generated by Claude Sonnet 5
Top genres card renders empty when history is unseeded (no empty-state text)

action_items: Seed/ensure demo history inside /api/taste-profile/generate and /api/recommendations/generate so Claude gets real titles (currently produces 'no viewing history' profiles for fresh users)
Log the raw LLM response when _extract_json() fails and retry once before falling back to DEMO_RECS (fixes intermittent provider='demo')
Attach real poster art (or distinct placeholders) to Claude-generated recommendations
Update Recommendations page copy to not claim Ollama when provider is claude/demo
critical_code_review_comments: insert_many() mutates the passed dicts by adding _id; any code that reuses that list for a response must strip _id (fixed in both auto-seed branches of server.py)
generate_with_llm() swallows parse failures with no diagnostics - impossible to distinguish 'LLM errored' from 'LLM returned unparseable JSON' from logs

/api/recommendations/saved is declared after /api/recommendations/{rec_id}/... routes; safe today only because those are POST - keep static segments declared before path params to avoid future shadowing
server.py is 655 lines and mixes auth, connections, history, LLM helpers and recs - consider splitting into routers
seed_data_creation: mongosh users/user_sessions: user_id=test-user-claude-1 token=test_session_claude_1 (auto-cleaned by pytest fixture); user_id=test-user-fe-claude token=test_session_fe_claude (left in DB for UI retests)
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty - used mongosh session seeding per /app/auth_testing.md. Browser cookie: session_token=test_session_fe_claude (domain smart-show-finder.preview.emergentagent.com, secure, sameSite=None)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend suite with `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -n 0 -v` (must be -n 0: classes share generated recommendation state, so xdist loadscope parallelism races). LLM calls take 10-40s; timeouts set to 180s. Claude fallback verified working end-to-end; if provider comes back 'demo' retry once before reporting - it is intermittent (~25%) due to unparseable LLM JSON. Frontend selectors used: generate-taste-button, profile-provider-badge, cinematic-dna-text, mood-badge, generate-recommendations-button, movie-card-{id}, save/info/dismiss-recommendation-button-{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/history 500: in the auto-seed branch the list handed to insert_many is mutated in place by pymongo to include an ObjectId '_id'; the response comprehension only stripped 'user_id', so FastAPI/Pydantic tried to serialize ObjectId and raised ValueError -> 500. Fixed by excluding both 'user_id' and '_id' in the history and recommendations auto-seed branches.
